iso_scanner.behavior: Reads iso-scan/filename and calls find_path; panics with the observed ISO-not-found error when that search fails.

helpers.behavior: find_path attempts a filesystem only when is_supported_fs accepts its detected type. exFAT is excluded; NTFS is accepted.

conclusion: GRUB exFAT support does not make this Casper ISO scanner accept an exFAT carrier. Use NTFS for large Casper ISOs without modifying the signed publisher media.
verification_method: Unprivileged extraction from the existing verified ISO using bsdtar, CPIO stream boundary inspection and zstd. No host mounts, block devices or module changes.
